content_sections.heading: About PMBI (Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India)
content_sections.text: PMBI is the implementing agency for the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) and is registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860. Through this PMBI Recruitment 2026 notification, the Bureau is hiring contractual staff at various levels - from Executive to General Manager - to support its Sales & Marketing, Procurement, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, HR, Legal, Media, Grievance Redressal, International Assistance and Coordination functions.

content_sections.heading: PMBI Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention a separate application start date; candidates may send their applications any time up to the last date. Any corrigendum or clarification will be notified only through the official PMBI website.

content_sections.heading: PMBI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay an application fee of Rs. 100 in the form of a Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)" . The original Demand Draft must be attached with the application form. Applications submitted without the Demand Draft will be rejected, and the fee will not be refunded even if the recruitment is cancelled for any reason.

content_sections.heading: PMBI Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Pay is structured as a monthly consolidated amount that differs by post and department, ranging from Rs. 32,500/month (Executive-level posts) up to Rs. 1,58,000/month (General Manager-level posts), as detailed in the post-wise tables above. In addition to consolidated pay, most posts also carry Conveyance Allowance (Rs. 500 to Rs. 15,000/month) and Telephone Allowance (Rs. 500 to Rs. 2,000/month), along with Provident Fund as per norms, Group Mediclaim Policy (Rs. 5 Lacs or Rs. 10 Lacs), Group Term Life Insurance (Rs. 10 Lacs) and Group Accidental Insurance (Rs. 10 Lacs). No other benefits, amenities, perks or allowances are payable, as per the General Terms & Conditions.

content_sections.heading: PMBI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for PMBI Recruitment 2026 follows a three-stage process: Initial Screening: The duly filled application form, along with copies of educational and experience documents, is checked and verified against the eligibility criteria for the post applied for. Written Examination: Screened eligible candidates are called for a written exam based on English language writing skills, subject knowledge related to the post, and general knowledge. No conveyance is paid for appearing in the written exam. Date, time, venue and syllabus are communicated to eligible candidates by email before the exam. Personal Interaction cum Interview: Candidates who qualify the written exam are called for a Personal Interaction cum Interview. Based on credentials and interview performance, the offer of appointment is issued to suitable candidates in order of merit. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. Candidates must carry all original supporting documents (mark sheets, degree certificates, experience certificates, etc.) along with one set of photocopies at the time of the Personal Interaction cum Interview, for verification.

Send the complete application by post/courier to: CEO, PMBI, B-500, Tower B, 5th Floor, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi – 110029. content_sections.heading: PMBI Recruitment 2026: General Terms & Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely contractual and does not entitle any candidate to claim regular/permanent employment in PMBI. Selected candidates are liable to be transferred/posted anywhere in India at PMBI's discretion. The initial contract is for 3 years, extendable based on performance; there is a 6-month observation period during the first year. If an employee resigns or abandons service within the first year (including the observation period) or violates appointment terms, liquidated damages equal to 3 months' consolidated pay are payable. During the 6-month observation period, the contract can be terminated by giving 7 days' notice if performance is unsatisfactory. After the observation period, the contract can be terminated by giving 30 days' notice or 30 days' remuneration in lieu thereof. The number of posts may be increased or decreased based on internal department requirements. Candidates are advised to check their email regularly for updates; no TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. For assistance, candidates may call PMBI on 011-49431800.

faq.question: Q1. What is PMBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: PMBI Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 02/2026) is a notification issued by the Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India inviting applications for 178 contractual vacancies across 44 posts in departments such as Sales & Marketing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics & Supply Chain, Finance & Accounts, IT & MIS, HR & Administration, Legal, Media, Grievance Division, International Assistance Division and Coordination Cell.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PMBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 178 vacancies are available across 11 post categories and 44 specific designations, as listed in the vacancy details table above.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PMBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the hard copy application is 24 September 2026, till 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for PMBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the post applied for and ranges from a general Graduate degree to B.Pharma/M.Pharma, B.Sc (Biotech/Medicinal Chemistry/Pharmaceutical Chemistry), BVSc & AH, B.Com/M.Com, B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA, LLB, and Graduation in Mass Communication/Journalism. See the post-wise eligibility tables above for exact requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for PMBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit varies from 28 years (Executive-level posts) to 55 years (General Manager-level posts), with the cut-off date being the date of publishing of the advertisement (03 September 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PMBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100, payable only through a Demand Draft in favour of "Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)".

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for PMBI Recruitment 2026? Is there an apply online option?
faq.answer: There is no apply-online facility mentioned in the notification. Candidates must send a duly filled hard-copy application, with supporting documents and the Demand Draft, by post/courier to the CEO, PMBI, New Delhi, on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for PMBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves three stages: Initial Screening of application and documents, a Written Examination, and a Personal Interaction cum Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for PMBI Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated monthly pay ranges from Rs. 32,500 to Rs. 1,58,000 depending on the post, plus conveyance allowance, telephone allowance, PF, and group insurance benefits as applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is PMBI Recruitment 2026 for permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No. The notification is explicit that these are contractual appointments for an initial period of 3 years and do not entitle candidates to claim regular or permanent employment in PMBI.
